map.计算车辆装载的体积利用率与重量利用率，判断是体积受限还是重量受限，并估算可装载件: Computes the volume utilization and weight utilization of a vehicle load, judges whether volume or weight is the limiting factor, and estimates how many pieces can be loaded.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：max(planVolUtil, planWeigh: Core formula (by input variables): max(planVolUtil, planWeightUtil, 100); bWeight × min(planQty, maxQty); boxVol × min(planQty, maxQty)
map.📖 查看「装载利用率 使用指南」: 📖 View the guide to loading utilization
map.= 货物总体积 ÷ 车厢容积 × 100%: = total cargo volume ÷ cargo body capacity × 100%
map.：当体积利用率先达到 100% 为体积受限，当重量利用率先达到 100% 为重量: : if volume utilization reaches 100% first it is volume-limited, and if weight utilization reaches 100% first it is weight-limited. Actual loading must also consider the number of stacking layers, stability and so on.
map.本工具按理想长方体堆叠估算，未考虑货物摆放方向、间隙、堆码承重等实际因素，结果仅: This tool estimates on the basis of ideal rectangular stacking and does not account for real factors such as cargo orientation, gaps or stacking load limits, so the results are for reference only.
map.最大可装件数（体积侧）：对 3 种正交摆放取向 (长,宽,高)、(长,高,宽)、: Maximum number of pieces (volume side): for the 3 orthogonal orientations (length, width, height), (length, height, width) and (width, height, length), compute floor(body length ÷ first side) × floor(body width ÷ second side) × floor(body height ÷ third side), and take the largest of the three as the volume limit.
map.重量约束与受限类型判定：受重量限制的最大件数=floor(车辆载重÷单件重量)，: Weight constraint and limiting factor: the maximum number of pieces allowed by weight = floor(vehicle payload ÷ weight per piece), and the final maximum = min(volume limit, weight limit). When the volume limit is less than or equal to the weight limit it is judged volume-limited, otherwise weight-limited, which decides the direction of optimization (change the stacking pattern or switch to a vehicle with a larger payload).
map.计划装载校验：按计划件数计算总体积与总重量及对应利用率，超过体积上限标「超装」、: Planned load check: compute the total volume, total weight and the corresponding utilization for the planned piece count; exceeding the volume limit is flagged as over volume, exceeding the weight limit as overloaded, and utilization above 90% as nearly full — used to review before departure whether an extra vehicle is needed or the load must be reduced.
map.算例：6.8 m 厢车装 0.6×0.4×0.5 m 纸箱: Worked example: loading 0.6 × 0.4 × 0.5 m cartons into a 6.8 m van
map.输入：车厢 6.8×2.3×2.4 m（容积 37.536 m³）、载重 500: Input: cargo body 6.8 × 2.3 × 2.4 m (capacity 37.536 m³), payload 5000 kg; carton 0.6 × 0.4 × 0.5 m (0.12 m³ per piece), 15 kg per piece; 500 pieces planned. Three orientations: (0.6,0.4,0.5) → 11 × 5 × 4 = 220 pieces, (0.6,0.5,0.4) → 11 × 4 × 6 = 264 pieces, (0.4,0.5,0.6) → 17 × 4 × 4 = 272 pieces, taking the largest at 272 pieces. Weight limit = floor(5000 ÷ 15) = 333 pieces. Maximum loadable pieces = min(272, 333) = 272, limiting factor = volume-limited; at 272 pieces, volume utilization is 87.0% and weight utilization 81.6%. The planned 500 pieces need 60.00 m³ (159.8%) and 7500 kg (150.0%), exceeding both volume and weight, so split the load into two vehicles or reduce it; if changed to 300 pieces it is 36.00 m³ (95.9%) and 4500 kg (90.0%), still above the 272-piece limit, so it really cannot be loaded.
map.为什么每个方向用向下取整而不是四舍五入？: Why round down in every direction instead of rounding to the nearest whole number?
map.车厢三边不可切分，任一方向只能放下整数件，向下取整保证不越界。同时实际装车还要扣: The three sides of the cargo body cannot be divided, and each direction can only hold a whole number of pieces, so rounding down guarantees no boundary is crossed. Real loading must also subtract pallet thickness, cargo gaps, door frame inset and stacking error; it is advisable to multiply the tool result by a real loading factor of 0.90 to 0.95 to get an executable loading plan.
map.只试 3 种摆放取向够吗？长方体不是有 6 种吗？: Are 3 orientations enough? Does a cuboid not have 6?
map.长方体正交摆放确有 6 种，但绕竖直轴旋转 180° 只是交换另外两边，在向下取: A cuboid does have 6 orthogonal orientations, but rotating 180° around the vertical axis merely swaps the other two sides, which in this floor-based counting model is equivalent to one of the groups already enumerated, so 3 orientations cover the distinct ways of assigning the three sides. If the cargo may not be inverted (for example cartons marked this way up), manually exclude orientations that turn the original height edge into the vertical direction.
map.装载利用率是一款旅行出行领域的在线工具。旅行出行工具，出行必备，支持离线使用。: Loading utilization is an online tool in the travel field. Travel tools are essential for going out and support offline use.
map.车厢容积 = 车长×车宽×车高；单件体积 = 箱长×箱宽×箱高: Cargo space = truck length × width × height; single-item volume = carton length × width × height
map.方向枚举：6 种朝向全排列 n = ⌊车长/箱长⌋×⌊车宽/箱宽⌋×⌊车高/箱高: Orientation enumeration: all 6 orientations, n = ⌊truck length/carton length⌋ × ⌊truck width/carton width⌋ × ⌊truck height/carton height⌋, take the maximum
map.单件尺寸大于车厢任一边时无法装载，直接提示: If a single item exceeds any truck dimension it cannot be loaded, reported directly
map.最大可装件数 = min(体积方向最优, 重量上限): Maximum loadable pieces = min(best volume orientation, weight limit)
map.体积利用率 = 计划件数×单件体积 ÷ 车厢容积 × 100%: Volume utilization = planned pieces × single-item volume ÷ cargo space × 100%
map.重量利用率 = 计划件数×单件重量 ÷ 额定载重 × 100%: Weight utilization = planned pieces × single-item weight ÷ rated payload × 100%
map.超装判定：分别对比体积/重量上限并预警；利用率 >90% 为接近满载: Overload check: compare against the volume and weight limits separately and warn; utilization > 90% counts as nearly full
map.最大可装件数（体积侧）：对 6 种正交摆放取向（长宽高三边全排列）分别计算 fl: Maximum loadable pieces (volume side): for each of the 6 orthogonal orientations (all permutations of length, width and height), compute floor(truck length ÷ first side) × floor(truck width ÷ second side) × floor(truck height ÷ third side); the largest of the six is the volume ceiling.
map.输入：车厢 6.8×2.3×2.4 m（容积 37.536 m³）、载重 500: Input: truck 6.8×2.3×2.4 m (volume 37.536 m³), payload 5000 kg; carton 0.6×0.4×0.5 m (0.12 m³ each), 15 kg each; plan 500 pieces. Six orientations: (0.6,0.4,0.5)→11×5×4=220 pcs, (0.6,0.5,0.4)→11×4×5=220 pcs, (0.4,0.6,0.5)→17×3×4=204 pcs, (0.4,0.5,0.6)→17×4×4=272 pcs, (0.5,0.6,0.4)→13×3×5=195 pcs, (0.5,0.4,0.6)→13×5×4=260 pcs, maximum 272 pcs. Weight limit = floor(5000÷15) = 333 pcs. Maximum loadable = min(272,333) = 272 pcs, limited by volume; loading 272 pcs gives 87.0% volume utilization and 81.6% weight utilization. Planning 500 pcs requires 60.00 m³ (159.8%) and 7500 kg (150.0%)—both volume and weight exceed the limits, so split into two trucks or reduce the quantity; 300 pcs needs 36.00 m³ (95.9%) and 4500 kg (90.0%), still above the 272-piece volume ceiling, so it still will not fit.
map.长方体正交摆放有 6 种三边分配方式，全部枚举后取最大值，避免只试 3 种时低估: A rectangular box has 6 orthogonal ways to assign its three sides; enumerating all and taking the maximum avoids underestimating the loadable count that comes from trying only 3 (for example, placing the longer side along the truck length can fit more). If the cargo cannot be tipped (e.g. cartons marked this side up), you can manually exclude orientations that turn the original height side vertical.
map.最大可装件数（体积侧）：枚举 6 种正交摆放取向，分别计算 floor(车厢长÷: Maximum piece count (volume side): enumerate 6 orthogonal orientations, compute floor(vehicle length ÷ first edge) × floor(vehicle width ÷ second edge) × floor(vehicle height ÷ third edge) for each, and take the largest as the volume limit. This limit is only a uniform-orientation grid estimate and does not search mixed orientations.
map.计划装载校验：计划件数须为 0 或正整数，按计划件数计算总体积与总重量及对应利用: Planned loading check: the planned quantity must be 0 or a positive integer. Compute total volume, total weight and their utilization; mark volume over the limit as "over volume" and weight over the limit as "overweight", and utilization above 90% as "near full". The result only shows whether the volume/weight limits are exceeded; it is not a real loading-safety conclusion after stacking strength, gaps, axle load and lashing.
map.仅保持原高度（水平旋转 2 种）: Keep original height only (2 horizontal rotations)
map.箱间/车厢边间隙（米）: Gap between cartons / at body walls (m)
map.最大堆码层数（0=按车厢高度）: Maximum stack layers (0 = by body height)
map.单轴/局部承载上限（kg，0=不限制）: Axle / local load limit (kg, 0 = no extra limit)
map.本工具已提供摆放方向、箱间间隙、堆码层数/承压与载重/单轴上限输入，但仍按统一朝: This tool now accepts orientation, carton gaps, stack layers/compression, payload and axle/local limits, but still estimates with a uniform-orientation grid. Pallet thickness, door-frame inset, lashing and actual front/rear axle distribution are not modeled, so the results are for reference only.
map.估算限制：按所选方向枚举统一朝向网格，不搜索同一车厢内混合朝向；间隙按每件均匀扣: Estimation limits: the selected orientations are enumerated as uniform-orientation grids, without searching mixed orientations in one body; gaps are deducted evenly around each carton, and pallet thickness, door-frame inset, lashing and actual front/rear axle distribution are not modeled. Stack layers/compression and the axle limit are converted to piece counts only; before real loading, verify against the vehicle manual and axle-load requirements, and apply a real-loading factor of 0.90–0.95.
map.最大可装件数（体积侧）：按所选方向（全部 6 种 / 仅保持原高度 / 固定朝向: Maximum piece count (volume side): according to the allowed orientations (all 6 / keep original height only / fixed), enumerate orthogonal placements and compute floor(body length ÷ (first edge + gap)) × floor(body width ÷ (second edge + gap)) × floor(body height ÷ (third edge + gap)); then cap the height layers by the maximum stack layers and carton compression limit, and take the maximum as the volume/orientation limit. It remains a uniform-orientation grid estimate and does not search mixed orientations in one body.
map.重量约束与受限类型判定：重量上限件数=floor(车辆载重×允许载重利用率上限÷: Weight limit and limiting factor: weight-limited pieces = floor(vehicle payload × allowed payload utilization ÷ weight per piece); if an axle/local load limit is entered, also take floor(axle limit ÷ weight per piece). Final maximum = min(volume/orientation limit, weight limit, axle limit), and whichever binds determines "volume/orientation-limited", "weight-limited" or "axle/local-load-limited". The axle limit is converted to pieces only and does not verify actual front/rear axle distribution.
map.计划装载校验：计划件数须为 0 或正整数，按计划件数计算总体积与总重量及对应利用: Planned loading check: the planned quantity must be 0 or a positive integer. Compute total volume, total weight and utilization; volume over the limit is "over volume", weight over the limit is "overweight", and utilization above 90% is "near full". Stack layers, carton compression and gaps are now converted from inputs, but pallet thickness, door-frame inset, lashing and actual front/rear axle distribution are not modeled; the result only shows whether volume/weight/axle limits are exceeded, not a real loading-safety conclusion.
map.按默认全部朝向、0 间隙、堆码不限、载重上限 100%、单轴不限：三种代表取向: With defaults (all orientations, 0 gap, unlimited stacking, 100% payload cap, no axle limit), three representative orientations give (0.6,0.4,0.5) → 11×5×4 = 220 pcs, (0.6,0.5,0.4) → 11×4×6 = 264 pcs, and (0.4,0.5,0.6) → 17×4×4 = 272 pcs, so the maximum is 272. Weight limit = floor(5000 × 100% ÷ 15) = 333 pcs. Maximum loadable = min(272,333) = 272, limiting factor = volume/orientation-limited; at 272 pcs volume utilization is 87.0% and weight utilization 81.6%. The planned 500 pcs need 60.00 m³ (159.8%) and 7500 kg (150.0%), exceeding both, so split into two vehicles or reduce the load; 300 pcs needs 36.00 m³ (95.9%) and 4500 kg (90.0%), still above the 272-piece ceiling, so it will not fit.
map.长方体正交摆放确有 6 种，但绕竖直轴旋转 180° 只是交换另外两边，在向下取: A cuboid does have 6 orthogonal orientations, but rotating 180° around the vertical axis merely swaps the other two sides, which in floor-based counting is equivalent to an already enumerated group, so 3 orientations cover the distinct three-side assignments. If the cargo may not be inverted (such as cartons marked this way up), set "Allowed orientations" to "Keep original height only" to try the two horizontal rotations; choosing "Fixed current orientation" disables rotation. The result is still only a uniform-orientation grid estimate and does not search mixed orientations.
